messages:
incident-bot: [ALERT] Region fallback loop detected for model-lock alice-quant-3 at 2024-11-12T09:15:01Z :rotating_light:

alice: i'm seeing spikes in 5xxs and routing to eu-west fallback. customers on eu region reporting high latency.

terry: @alice can you paste the routing policy? suspect locked model variant is incompatible (chat vs embeddings)

alice: copying policy...

```
route {
  primary: 'redwood/chat-3b:chat-variant'
  fallback: 'redwood/instruct-3b:instruct-variant'
  lock: model-lock:alice-quant-3
}
```

alice: but traffic shows embeddings requests hitting the chat variant after lock

mike: :eyes: that explains 500s from gen path. emb endpoint expects embedding-only variant

sam: oncall stepping in. switching to mitigation mode.

sre-oncall: paging in, what's customer impact? any paid customers affected?

alice: two enterprise tenants (tenant_acme, tenant-orbit) saw degraded embeddings; internal metrics show 8% error rate for embedding calls in eu-west, and p50 120ms -> p95 1.6s latency increase

sre-oncall: adding urgency: P1. recommend immediate rollback of model-lock or override fallback to embedding-compatible variant

terry: rolling policy override now: setting fallback -> redwood/embed-3b:embed-variant and removing lock

```
# command
redwoodctl policy update --route route-id-123 --fallback redwood/embed-3b:embed-variant --remove-lock model-lock:alice-quant-3
```

terry: applied, waiting for propagation :hourglass:

alice: logs show decreasing 5xx in eu-west

mike: running smoke tests against embeddings endpoint

sam: smoke checks OK for tenant_acme, p95 latency back to 220ms

sre-oncall: good. going to keep watch for 30m, initiating customer communications via support

alice: note: root cause appears to be stale model-lock created by model-pinning job during deploy; that job used generic compatibility tag and locked chat variant for all routes

terry: created issue infra#4521 to make model-locks variant-aware

mike: we'll also add guard in routing engine to reject lock when request-type mismatch

sam: handoff to night oncall in 30m @maria

sre-oncall: I'll summarize for pagerduty: 2345678901

sre-oncall: summary: wrong model lock (non-variant-aware) caused embeddings requests to fall back to incompatible chat variant in eu-west; mitigation: override fallback to embed variant and removed lock. customer impact: 2 enterprise tenants saw embedding errors and elevated latency (8% errors, p95 up to 1.6s). status: mitigated, monitoring.

incident-bot: Incident created INC-2024-341, severity P1 -> P2 on mitigation

maria: acknowledged, taking watch for next 2 hours

alice: adding postmortem owner @terry

terry: will draft postmortem, include rollout fix and guardrails

mike: adding tests to routing unit to catch variant mismatches

sam: closing loop with support to notify affected customers and issue credits if needed

alice: :thumbsup:
